evidence.observation: Pressure was 2.920 Torr at approximately 100 sccm Ar before growth.
Growth pressure has progressively increased to 3.191 Torr despite stable Ar flow (99.6 sccm) and temperature (750.0 C); this indicates a pressure trend not explained by changing setpoints.
Exhaust O2 sensor is not installed; O2 readings remain null.
Growth requires an exhaust O2 sensor, so the installed instrumentation does not meet the stated requirement and atmosphere cannot be verified.

args.missing_evidence: A functioning exhaust O2 sensor is required to verify atmosphere. Pressure acceptance limits and independent pressure, leak-integrity and exhaust-conductance checks are needed to distinguish the cause of the pressure rise. No sample characterization is available.
